limits.en: Unlimited forms and submissions within fair-usage guidelines; payments, e-signatures, file uploads (10MB/file), conditional logic, 45+ languages.

keyLimits.en: Unlimited forms and submissions within fair-usage guidelines; 10MB per-file upload cap.
Removes Tally branding, custom domains, unlimited team collaboration, unlimited file uploads, extended analytics and version history.

cautions.en: Annual billing is described as '2 months free' (roughly a 17% discount) versus monthly, but the exact annual-per-month figure was not itemized on the page.
The free plan already covers most solo use cases (unlimited forms/submissions, payments, e-signatures); Pro mainly buys branding removal and team features.

capabilities.en: Notion-style block-based form builder with conditional logic and payment/e-signature collection.
Native integrations with Google Sheets, Notion, Airtable, Zapier, Make and webhooks.

limitations.en: Free plan caps file uploads at 10MB per file; removed only on the Pro plan.
Custom domains and branding removal require the paid Pro plan.

reason.en: Direct form-builder competitor, more polished but priced higher.
Established form builder competitor with a comparable freemium model.
Newer flexible form-builder competitor in the same segment.

unknowns: Exact annual per-month price for Pro and Business plans was not captured; only the monthly rate and a general 'save 2 months' claim were shown.
